pii: workflow, version, execution, revision, epoch and outcome codes
no message body, prompt, attachment bytes or credentials
dataCatalogAdditions.purpose: Fence automation, deliver idempotent commands and reconcile uncertain outcomes.
systemsAndCopies: PostgreSQL conversations, messages, n8n_events, n8n_commands and reconciliation_items
dataCatalogAdditions.trigger: Automation run or command reaches a terminal outcome.
dataCatalogAdditions.destination: Delete execution and manual metadata while retaining only separately authorized audit data or the minimum idempotency tombstone.
dataCatalogAdditions.legalHold: Minimum scoped exception only; never preserve credentials or message bodies in technical state.
deletionPropagation: CRM technical tables and reconciliation payloads
n8n execution history and manual data

threatModelAdditions.asset: conversation state and authorized automation commands
threatModelAdditions.boundary: n8n to CRM API and CRM worker to n8n webhook
threatModelAdditions.mitigation: Distinct rotating Basic credentials, TLS, action allowlist, immutable payload hash, idempotency and workflow correlation.
threatModelAdditions.test: Invalid Basic, divergent replay, wrong workflow identity and forbidden action produce no effect and leak no credential.

threatModelAdditions.asset: customer messages and official conversation state
threatModelAdditions.boundary: n8n AI execution to Meta send
threatModelAdditions.mitigation: The one-use message.send.requested reservation validates conversation mode, inbound revision and automation epoch before Meta.
threatModelAdditions.test: Takeover during generation and replay after authorization never permit a second or stale Meta send.

retention.transientMedia: earliest of journey termination or seven days
